visaPage.heroSubtitle: JetSet Travel Cyprus provides professional visa coordination services for business and leisure travellers. From Schengen and UK visas to US, UAE, and Russian applications — our experienced team handles document preparation, embassy coordination, and status tracking so you can travel with confidence.
visaPage.heroImageAlt: Visa application documents and passport for travel services
visaPage.introP1: Since 2006, JetSet Travel has helped hundreds of travellers based in Paphos and across Cyprus navigate the visa application process. As an IATA-accredited travel agency (accreditation 14200130) with Cyprus Tourism Licence 7775, we bring nearly two decades of experience to every visa case — from straightforward tourist applications to complex multi-entry business visas.
visaPage.introP2: We work directly with embassies, consulates, and visa application centres to stay current on changing requirements, processing times, and documentation standards. Whether you need a Schengen visa for a European business trip or a US B1/B2 visa for a conference, our team ensures your application is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
visaPage.visaTypesSubtitle: We handle applications for all major visa categories. Here are the destinations most frequently requested by our clients in Cyprus.
visaPage.schengenVisaDesc: The Schengen visa grants access to 27 European countries with a single application. We assist with both C-type short-stay tourist visas and business visas requiring invitation letters from European companies. Our team prepares your travel itinerary, ensures your travel insurance meets the minimum €30,000 coverage requirement, and coordinates submission with the relevant consulate in Nicosia or Limassol. Typical processing: 10–15 working days.
visaPage.ukVisaDesc: Post-Brexit, the UK requires a separate visa for most non-EU nationals. We assist with Standard Visitor visas for tourism, business meetings, and short courses, as well as longer-term visa categories. Our team helps you navigate the UKVI online application, biometric appointment booking, and document preparation including financial evidence and accommodation details. Typical processing: 15 working days.
visaPage.usVisaDesc: US visa applications require careful preparation, including DS-160 form completion and consular interview scheduling. We assist with B1 (business) and B2 (tourist) visa categories, helping you compile the required documentation — financial statements, employment verification, travel purpose evidence, and ties to your home country. We also provide interview preparation guidance. Typical processing: 3–6 weeks.
visaPage.uaeVisaDesc: The UAE offers relatively fast e-visa processing for most nationalities. We handle 30-day and 90-day tourist visas, multi-entry business visas, and transit visas for Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and other Emirates. Our team manages the online application, passport scan submission, and approval tracking. Typical processing: 3–5 working days.
visaPage.russiaVisaDesc: Russian visa applications require an official invitation letter (tourist voucher or business invitation) and specific documentation. We coordinate with authorised Russian travel providers to obtain invitation letters, assist with the online application form, and schedule your appointment at the Russian Embassy or Visa Application Centre. Typical processing: 4–10 working days.
visaPage.destSubtitle: Processing times and difficulty levels for the most requested visas from Cyprus.

visaPage.step1Desc: Contact us with your destination, nationality, and travel dates. We assess your visa requirements and advise on the best application strategy — at no charge.
visaPage.step2Desc: We send you a personalised checklist of every document required for your specific visa category, nationality, and travel purpose. No guesswork.
visaPage.step3Desc: Our team reviews all your documents for completeness and accuracy, fills out application forms on your behalf, and flags any potential issues before submission.
visaPage.step4Desc: We submit your application to the embassy, consulate, or visa centre — handling fees, appointment scheduling, and any supplementary document requests.

visaPage.faq1Q: How long does a Schengen visa take from Cyprus?
visaPage.faq1A: Standard Schengen visa processing takes 10–15 working days from the date of submission. During peak travel season (May–September), processing may extend to 20–30 days. We recommend applying at least 6 weeks before your travel date. Our team submits complete, error-free applications to help avoid delays caused by missing documents or incorrect forms.
visaPage.faq2Q: What documents do I need for a business visa?
visaPage.faq2A: Business visa requirements vary by destination, but generally include: a valid passport, recent photographs, a formal invitation letter from the host company, proof of employment or business registration, bank statements covering the last 3–6 months, travel insurance, and flight and hotel reservations. During your free consultation, we provide a detailed checklist specific to your destination and nationality.
visaPage.faq3Q: Do you handle visa applications for groups?
visaPage.faq3A: Yes. We regularly process group visa applications for corporate delegations, conference attendees, and tour groups. Group applications benefit from coordinated submission, consistent documentation standards, and a single point of contact. We manage all logistics including group appointment scheduling at embassies and visa centres.
visaPage.faq4Q: Can you help with urgent or express visa processing?
visaPage.faq4A: Many embassies and visa centres offer express or priority processing for an additional fee. We can arrange expedited submissions where available — for example, UAE visas can be fast-tracked to 24–48 hours, and some Schengen consulates offer priority appointments. Contact us with your travel date and we will advise on the fastest available option.
visaPage.faq5Q: How much do your visa services cost?
visaPage.faq5A: Our service fee depends on the visa type, destination, and complexity of your application. We provide a clear quote during your free initial consultation — no hidden charges. The fee covers document review, application preparation, submission coordination, and status tracking. Embassy and visa centre fees are charged separately and paid directly to the issuing authority.

cruisesPage.faq1Q: How far in advance should I book a cruise?
cruisesPage.faq1A: We recommend booking 9–12 months ahead for the best cabin selection and early-bird pricing, though last-minute deals are sometimes available. For world cruises or new ship launches, booking 12–18 months ahead is advisable.
cruisesPage.faq2Q: What is included in a cruise fare?

cruisesPage.faq4Q: What is the difference between cabin types?

cruisesPage.faq5Q: Do I need a visa for cruise ports?

cruisesPage.faq6A: Travel insurance is not included in cruise fares but is strongly recommended. We can help you find appropriate coverage for your cruise, including trip cancellation and medical coverage.
cruisesPage.faq7Q: Can JetSet arrange pre and post cruise hotel stays?

cruisesPage.faq8Q: What are the best cruises for families with children?

cruisesPage.faq9Q: What is the best time to cruise the Mediterranean / Caribbean / Alaska?
